newsitem.title: USA: ADM to close soybean plant for crop year.
newsitem.headline: ADM to close soybean plant for crop year.

text.p: Archer Daniels Midland Co said Wednesday it was closing its Clarksdale, Mississippi, soybean processing plant for the rest of the crop year.
ADM also said crush rates in Taylorville, Illinois; Little Rock, Arkansas; and Mexico, Missouri, were reduced due to downward pressure on processing margins resulting from foreign vegetable oil.
Cash soymeal dealers have expected soybean processors to reduce production this week or next week because of poor operating margins.
Losses on crush operations ranged from less than 10 cents a bushel to nearly 20 cents, dealers said.
Dealers said the processing slowdown should be reflected in the National Oilseed Processors Association weekly soybean processing report to be released Thursday.
They expect the report to show weekly soybean crushings below 30 million bushels, versus 30.106 million in the week ended March 12.
Shares of the agribusiness giant were down 3/8 at 17-7/8 Wednesday.
